note: Approximate positions of the CUrW canal gauges. CUrW publishes no coordinates, but its public 'all locations' gauge map (pub.curwsl.org node/58, read 27 Oct 2026) names every gauge on a basemap: each position here was read off that map (affine fit to seven landmarks, about 100 m) and checked against Google Maps / OpenStreetMap for Mutwal tunnel inlet, Kalu Palama gates, Ambatale, Ingurukade, Orugodawatta, Kimbulawala Bridge, Diyasaru Park, Lanka Hospital and Janakala Kendraya, then snapped to the nearest OpenStreetMap canal when one lay within 200 m. Still not surveyed: the map says so. Sedawatta Bridge DS and Aluthkade are the two dots the CUrW map leaves unlabelled (inferred from the gauge list). Ranwala N, Kaduwela N and Awerihena Tank are outside the map box and not drawn.
